# Fallout Prime (Season 2) New photos from the set

![Fallout Prime (Season 2) New Photos from Set](/uploads/464_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

*Image: © JoJo Whilden / Amazon Studios*

The Fallout series on Amazon Prime * was a complete success in 2024. The series not only landed at number 1 on Amazon Prime's streaming charts, it was also a great advertisement for the Fallout games. And Fallout 76 also reached new player number records.

## Filming delayed

Filming of Season 2 was scheduled for early January 2025 and was delayed by the fires in Los Angeles. In the first season there were almost 10 months between the end of filming and the broadcast. So we can probably expect the second season to be broadcast in 2026.

## New signing: Macaulay Culkin

Home Alone star Macaulay Culkin has been announced as a new face for season 2. He is said to have a recurring role as a "crazy genius guy". That's something to look forward to. After the Home Alone films, we hardly heard about his acting career.

## Pictures from the Fallout set

As with the last season, the first photos from the film set have now appeared on Reddit.

![Fallout Prime Series Movie Set Photos](/uploads/fallout-prime-season2-set-1.jpeg) 

![Fallout Prime Series Movie Set Photos](/uploads/fallout-prime-season2-set-2.jpeg) 

Let's see what leaks and advance information we come across before it airs and how the story of Fallout will continue. Then current is the story of the series, the most advanced of all Fallout games. Everything looks like the Fallout story will continue to be written in New Vegas in 2296.
